C1250.title: Haikou Police Crack SMS Verification Code Prepaid Card Money Laundering Case
C1250.summary: In November 2020, Haikou police cracked a black and gray market case involving Tian, upstream and downstream card dealers and number dealers, and SMS receiving platform personnel. The people involved used illegally obtained mobile verification codes to help others buy large quantities of phone recharge cards for profit, and downstream black-gray markets could further use them for fund transfer or money laundering. The case reflects chain risks among SMS receiving platforms, verification code abuse, and recharge card monetization.
